stories.headline: FBR extends 2026 income-tax return filing deadline to October 15
stories.summary: Pakistan's Federal Board of Revenue extended the deadline for filing income-tax returns for tax year 2026 to October 15 after requests from trade bodies and professionals.
stories.why_it_matters: The extension affects national tax compliance and revenue administration and is a directly testable current-affairs fact.

sources.title: FBR extends deadline for filing income tax returns to Oct 15

stories.headline: Federal Constitutional Court narrows application of workplace-harassment law
stories.summary: A Federal Constitutional Court judgment set aside an Islamabad High Court verdict and held that the workplace-harassment law is invoked where harassment is sexual in nature, prompting criticism from lawyers.
stories.why_it_matters: The ruling is important for Pakistan's evolving constitutional and workplace-harassment jurisprudence.

sources.title: Lawyers criticise FCC judgement setting aside IHC verdict in workplace harassment case

stories.headline: Peshawar High Court calls Attorney General over delayed NFC Award
stories.summary: The Peshawar High Court called the Attorney General in proceedings concerning delay in a revised National Finance Commission Award and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's share.
stories.why_it_matters: The NFC Award is central to fiscal federalism and distribution of divisible-pool revenues among the federation and provinces.

sources.title: Peshawar High court calls attorney general over delayed NFC Award
